options.title: LtdLens settings
options.dataSource.help: Demo mode is useful for trying LtdLens out. It makes no network requests at all.
options.workerUrl.help: Leave this alone unless you are running your own copy.
options.history: Keep a local history of checks
options.history.help: Stored only in this browser. Never sent anywhere.
options.cacheMaxAge.help: Older reports are shown only when the lookup service cannot be reached, and always with their date.
options.clearData.help: Removes your history and every saved report from this browser.
privacy.title: What LtdLens does with your data
privacy.body: Nothing you look up is stored anywhere but this browser. There is no account, no identifier, and no analytics. The lookup service receives a company number and returns public register data; it keeps no request log.
disclaimer: Factual summary of public records. Not a credit rating, credit reference or financial advice.
